description: Admin UI surface for managing mcp_policy_rules records. Must interface with write_service at :8772 for CRUD operations. Table: mcp_policy_rules with columns rule_type (PRIORITY_OVERRIDE, RISK_FLOOR, SIGNAL_WEIGHT_ADJUST, EXEMPTION_CONDITION) and pattern (regex string). Must include create, read, update, delete operations with audit_log entries for all mutations. Binds localhost port 8790. Do not propose GraphQL or any out-of-scope surface per section 9.
